caseName: Tuscarora Nation of Indians v. Power Authority
caseNameFull: Tuscarora Nation of Indians, also known as Tuscarora Indian Nation v. Power Authority of New York, 358 U. S. 841

opinions.text:
Motion to substitute John Burch McMorran in the place of John W. Johnson as a party respondent granted. Motion for leave to file petition for rehearing denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and application. •
